title: Cucumber Salmon Roll Salad
blurb: Warm pan-seared salmon cubes over cool cucumber ribbons with creamy white and spicy-sweet sauces, red onion, and herbs.

title: Mediterranean Cucumber Salad
blurb: Crisp cucumber, leafy herbs, sharp red onion, lime dressing, and crumbly feta — tossed until bright and glossy.

title: Crispy Edamame Cucumber Salad
blurb: Cool cucumber and avocado topped with blistered crispy edamame, red onion, herbs, and a limey dressing.

title: Spam Musubi
blurb: Glazed Spam pressed with sushi rice and furikake, wrapped in nori — complete recipe from the caption.

title: Tomato Beef Soup (罗宋汤)
blurb: Waterless tomato-beef soup — tomatoes and cabbage make the broth under tender chuck roast.

title: 10-Minute Spicy Chicken Udon (麻辣雞絲烏冬)
blurb: Chewy udon with shredded chicken, crab sticks, cucumber, spicy sesame-vinegar sauce, and soft eggs.

title: Carbonara
blurb: Classic Roman carbonara — guanciale, eggs, pecorino, black pepper, pasta water. No cream.

title: High Protein Crispy Hot Honey Chicken Mac & Cheese
blurb: Air-fried cornflour-crisped chicken glazed in hot honey over creamy light mac & cheese — 4 serves, ~688 cal / 63P each.

title: Calamari a la Andaluza
blurb: Lightly floured calamari rings fried golden in olive oil, finished with salt and lemon — Andalusian classic.

title: Avocado Sushi Bake
blurb: Warm sushi-rice bake topped with salmon, avocado, nori, sesame, and drizzle sauces — deconstructed sushi casserole.

title: Hot Honey Crispy Chicken Burger
blurb: Buttermilk-marinated crispy chicken glazed in sticky hot honey with a lemony mayo sauce — approximate from caption.
